openings.claim: Evidence deletion could widen a defensible divergence interval without forcing a false earliest-stage answer. Replace local clocks with manifest stage order for corresponding recorded input/output digest comparisons, and a stage label with a record-linked boundary bracket; missing boundaries remain unknown.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: timestamp-ordered earliest-mismatch scan. It ranks anomalously early export before parse; the bracket flags clock conflict, using manifest order only for recorded-stage comparison. Transform removal should preserve or widen uncertainty, never strengthen definite claims. Sealed answers could defeat localization despite this consistency.
openings.probe: Build one spreadsheet/script bracket-and-ledger template. Apply it to one three-pair subset and the rival to the other within sixty analyst minutes and twelve logged manual inspections per pair. Report earliest supported mismatch separately from explanation, or an unresolved interval; attach supplied record identifiers and one next check using remaining records, manifest or dictionary. Remove one randomly selected transform record from each of two affected pairs, preserving manifests, and revise affected outputs. Freeze both variants before opening two answer sheets. Use twenty additional minutes to compare supported claims, unresolved coverage and inspection costs against answers. Disjoint subsets allow error-mode inspection, not controlled performance estimation.
openings.uncertainty: Dictionary and manifest must establish comparable artifact boundaries; otherwise only unresolved intervals are justified. Definite earliest-stage claims require supplied record support beyond ordering conventions. Neither digest equality nor absent records excludes earlier divergence/reconvergence; absence does not prove nonexecution. Blank warnings supply no execution evidence. Defeat: unsupported narrowing after deletion, contradicted definite claims, or inability to complete useful checks within budgets. A stop cap alone is insufficient.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, complete rival/test, uncertainty, resource caveats and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Retain one bounded enabling probe; synthetic model artifact, without deployment or measured-improvement claims.
